'''The Corestrike Credit Repository and Ore Exchange''' was a business located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. Run by [[Altros Logan]], the Repository was the only sturdily built building in Corestrike. Logan hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to guard the Repository, fearing a robbery organized by [[Themog]].<ref name="HNNA" />
